title: Authorization
excerpt: Authorization MCP Apps can protect tools behind OAuth based authorization, as defined in the MCP specification. There are two approaches: Per server authorization — The entire MCP server requires authorization at connection time. Every request must include a valid token, regardless of which tool is being called. This is the simpler model when all tools are sensitive.
